matched_rmse: Native and shared origin+endpoint populations; unchanged fitted forecasts. Different training histories remain. Source: matched/metrics.csv.
calendar_coverage: Actual evaluated origins, not raw data coverage. Source: membership.csv.gz.
seed_rmse: Five fixed seeds on three time-stratified folds per cell; points can overlap. Horizontal lines are unchanged deterministic baselines. Source: seed_metrics.csv.
seed_ranks: Five optimization seeds, not independent historical samples. Source: seed_metrics.csv.
paired_loss_intervals: Marginal percentile intervals are not Holm-simultaneous intervals. Adjusted HAC p-values are in comparisons.csv; these are retrospective follow-ups.
dependence_sensitivity: RF versus zero, block lengths 20/40/80; 2,000 paired replicates per point.
nominal_coverage: Trailing 504 mature residuals, minimum 252; exclusions counted in metrics.csv. No time-series coverage guarantee is asserted.
volatility_coverage: Trailing intervals by training-defined regimes; diagnostic conditional coverage.
width_coverage: Circles: trailing; squares: expanding; triangles: volatility scaled. Colors identify models. Proper interval scores are also reported; wider is not automatically better.
covid_intervals: Bounds use earlier matured OOS residuals. Returns realize 20 sessions after each plotted origin; overlapping targets are dependent.
